row: Looking to move well, feel better or perform at your best?  Dr. Erin Strauch-Ducat and the team at Reset Chiropractic & Wellness Center (formally Ducat Chiropractic) in Bloomingdale, IL specialize in the diagnosis and natural treatment of muscle, joint or nerve injuries.  They treat a variety of conditions from spinal pain to headache to rotator cuff injuries to plantar fasciitis to stubborn sports injuries  To help you get better as quickly as possible, they pinpoint the cause of your symptoms, custom design a treatment plan around you and pride themselves in one-on-one care.  Check out our  YouTube channel to learn more about our practice and learn a little bit about how to move better too!  Our website is https://www.reset-chiropractic.com.  Book your appointment online or call/text us at 224-653-8094
